title: Function-type field in an interface is not supported
expectedDiagnosticContains: interface fields may not have function types; use a method instead
notes: Interfaces do not support function-type fields. The source now parses (fn(number, number) number is a valid type since return types dropped the colon), so the rejection comes from the interface check rather than the parser -- the old expectation named a struct-field diagnostic that no longer fires.
